g.text: Restaurant Rush - sequence diagram (1/4): the Critic's visit in the Stage 3 victory run - turn 7 arrival and seating
C3 is a Critic: arrival #3 on turn 7, loses 12 satisfaction per waiting turn,
and reacts to how fresh the food is when it is served.
Manager choices that change the outcome
(1) Turn 8: switch on Happy Hour, so C3 recovers 15 at the start of turns 8 and 9.
C3 pays with satisfaction 100 instead of 76 (average 89.4 instead of 84.6).
(2) Turn 9: serve C3 on the first turn the dish can be served, so it is fresh.
Serving it on turn 10 instead costs one more waiting turn (-12) and the
cold-food penalty (-20): C3 pays with 68, and the average falls to 79.8.
called by Main.play(). Only turns 7-11 (C3's visit)
are drawn; every other turn runs the same steps
t = 7: C3 arrives, the Host seats C3, the Waiter takes the order, the Chef starts cooking
Step 2-3: Host, then Waiter, then Chef
[until result.success() - a rejected choice is reported and asked again; the task is not used up]
